uncertainty_notes: GenScript is a global institutional CDMO/biotech, not a research-peptide retail vendor. The following fields are 'uncertain' for documented reasons: (1) product_page_anatomy.photographic_treatment / coa_hosting / lab_partner_named / customer_review_module_present / related_product_modules_present — individual product detail pages (e.g. RP30917-BPC_157.html) returned HTTP 403 from curl on the live site (Cloudflare anti-bot challenge) and 404 from archive.org Wayback Machine across 2024/2025/2026 captures; the 3-attempt rule was followed (curl direct → gstack:browse failed under root sandbox → archive.org); per Rule 9 we did not bypass anti-bot. (2) checkout_flow.guest_checkout_available / id_verification_present / payment_methods_accepted / shipping_carriers / shipping_cost_structure — checkout requires SIGN IN at /customer/login (line 10 of homepage.md) and the 'Quick Order' / 'Request a Quote' flow shifts to a B2B quote-request form rather than retail checkout; per §11 bounds we did not create an account. The pricing visible on catalog_peptides.md is for ~200 in-stock catalog peptides, but most peptides are sold as custom-synthesis quotes (mg-to-kg, >300 modifications, 5-day Turbotide service) that do not have a fixed published per-mg price. (3) social_proof.off_site_aggregators / visible_influencer_endorsements — institutional vendors like GenScript do not typically appear on Trustpilot or use influencer marketing; on-site testimonials are from named institutional scientists rather than peer reviews. (4) homepage.hero_imagery_style is an [INFERENCE] (clinical) backed by hero copy and HTML <title> 'leader in molecular cloning and gene synthesis, peptide synthesis, protein and antibody engineering'; specific banner image files (e.g. /gsimages/peptide/...) are referenced in CSS but not directly readable as text evidence. (5) tech_stack.platform_signal is an [INFERENCE] (custom) backed by self-hosted SensorsData SDK + custom PHP/Java enterprise stack signals; no Shopify/WooCommerce/BigCommerce signature was found in source HTML. (6) content_footprint.content_cadence — the news-blogs index is heavily JS-rendered and individual blog post dates were not enumerable from the saved snapshot. (7) trust_compliance.age_gate_present is 'false' because no age-gate appeared on the homepage, peptide-services, or catalog pages; institutional B2B research vendors do not typically gate by age. (8) per_mg_price_usd values are computed from list_price_usd / dose_value in mg using the smallest available pack (e.g. β-Amyloid (1-40) shows $114.00 with both 0.5 mg and 1 mg pack options; per-mg recorded against 0.5 mg pack); for peptides sold only at 1 mg the per-mg equals list price.
